name: Tiger Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Ajeck Rouack sends you after ten elder Stranglethorn tigers. Their deaths will prove your skill before the final test.

sections.title: A Test of Skill
sections.body: Ajeck Rouack sends you into the wilds to hunt ten elder Stranglethorn tigers. He says they are the hardest cats to track and the fiercest to overcome. Their deaths prepare you for a final trial. After it, he promises to proclaim you a master tiger hunter before Master Nesingwary.

faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack assigns the trial at Nesingwary's Expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale.
You are hunting ten elder Stranglethorn tigers.

faq.q: Why are elder Stranglethorn tigers singled out?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack says elder Stranglethorn tigers are the hardest local cats to find and the most ferocious to defeat.
This hunt follows the second stage of Ajeck Rouack's Tiger Mastery series.
